# References this tree quotes as they read on a day, rather than as claims about
# this commit. One entry per line: the document, a tab, and the reference exactly
# as the document carries it.
#
# An entry is a debt and not a dispensation. `.github/lint/pasted-line-reference.sh`
# refuses an entry whose reference has started agreeing with the tree again, and
# refuses an entry no document carries, so neither direction lets one outlive the
# repair it stands in for.
#
# Everything below is in `docs/catalogue-checklist.md`. That page is a record of
# two catalogue passes, one on 2026-08-07 and one on 2026-08-16, and it says of
# itself that a verdict recorded against one version says nothing about a later
# one. Its quotations are what the files carried on those days, and the lines
# have moved since for reasons the record is not about. Reading them as claims
# about this commit would refuse the page for being a record.
#
# What retires these is #119, which owns that page. The repair there is to name
# the revision each pass was made at, in the `<rev>:<path>:<line>:<content>` form
# the check reads, so that a dated quotation is resolved at its own date and this
# register is not needed for it. Nothing here decides that for #119, and no line
# of that page is edited from this file.
